required_e2e_evidence_before_rc.title: End-to-end governed operation trace
required_e2e_evidence_before_rc.required_evidence: A complete trace from request envelope to policy evaluation, producer-bound state mutation, evidence record and audit receipt.

required_e2e_evidence_before_rc.title: Fail-closed negative trace
required_e2e_evidence_before_rc.required_evidence: A complete trace showing unauthorized or malformed action blocked without execution authorization.

required_e2e_evidence_before_rc.title: Recovery continuation trace
required_e2e_evidence_before_rc.required_evidence: A complete trace showing terminal/blocking state recovery through new governed object/version with prior history preserved.

required_e2e_evidence_before_rc.title: Contract-control lifecycle trace
required_e2e_evidence_before_rc.required_evidence: A complete trace showing CONTRACT::* transition produced only by PRODUCER::CONTRACT_CONTROL.

required_e2e_evidence_before_rc.title: Evidence pack integrity snapshot
required_e2e_evidence_before_rc.required_evidence: A hash-bound EvidencePack tying runtime outputs, source artifact hashes, test outputs and repository commit.

required_e2e_evidence_before_rc.title: External validation boundary
required_e2e_evidence_before_rc.required_evidence: A clearly scoped external validation artifact or explicit statement that external validation is not yet complete.

required_e2e_evidence_before_rc.title: Pilot/customer access boundary
required_e2e_evidence_before_rc.required_evidence: A pilot access gate proving whether customer-facing access remains blocked or has explicit authorized release conditions.
